03:47 < Filip> (that version also contains a slightly modified UI with the same logo as the booting kernel)

03:59 < Filip> old P75/12MB RAM notebook running of a 32MB CF card in IDE mode

04:00 < Filip> would be a great tool for testing range and play with antenna positions
04:00 < Filip> and just drive around ;-)
